tasks.summary_pl: Skarbiec: ciąg monet. Najmn. $k$ i dzień min. liczby monet (suma)
tasks.summary_en: Vault coin sequence. Smallest $k$ and day of min coins (sum)
tasks.statement_en: There were $k$ coins in the royal treasury. On the morning of the first day the treasurer added 25 coins, and each following morning he added 2 more coins than the previous day. At the same time, each day at noon the king took 50 coins out of the treasury. Compute the smallest number $k$ for which there was at least one coin in the treasury on every day, and then, for that value of $k$, find on which day the treasury held the fewest coins.

tasks.summary_en: White:black $=3:1$, $P$(different colors)$>\frac{9}{22}$. How many balls in the urn? (sum)
tasks.statement_en: An urn contains only white and black balls. There are three times as many white balls as black balls. Compute how many balls are in the urn, given that when two balls are drawn simultaneously, the probability of drawing balls of different colors is greater than $\frac{9}{22}$.
tasks.notes: Two integer values of n (black balls) satisfy the inequality, giving 4 or 8 balls total; sum of both valid answers [verified: ok: P=3n/(2(4n-1))>9/22 gives n<3, n=1,2 -> 4 or 8 balls (key). Plain numbers, sum 12 unambiguous. Summary fix: diacritics only.]

tasks.summary_en: Regular triangular pyramid, lateral edge $2a$: cos(lateral, base edge)
tasks.statement_en: A regular triangular pyramid is given in which the base edge has length $a$ and the lateral edge is twice as long. Compute the cosine of the angle between a lateral edge and a base edge of the pyramid. Sketch the cross-section of the pyramid by the plane passing through a base edge and the midpoint of the opposite lateral edge, and compute the area of this cross-section.
tasks.notes: Only the cosine (part a) is a plain number; the cross-section area (part b) is symbolic in a (P=a^2*sqrt5/4), not summed
